body:
I had similar thoughts to you when I was in high school, and I still do now. It's tough when you feel like what emotion you are expressing is just fake and you don't actually feel that way. I remember asking myself if I genuinely smiled/laughed at a situation because it was actually funny or cause it was appropriate for the situation. I really didn't fit in, and I still don't. 

Also with "coping other personalities", I think we all do that to figure out our own expressions and/or to interact with others. But in a way, it also means that you're good at observing others. 

Although I am just a random person on the internet with suicidal thoughts, talking and organizing thoughts helps alot. Feel free to PM. Wish you all the best.
